units.source_text: 你大约还不至于忘却我们吧。”

en.t: Surely you have not forgotten us yet, have you?"

units.source_text: 藏人少将持信来到一条院，率然直入。

en.t: The Kuroudo Lesser Captain brought the letter to Ichijo-in and walked straight in without hesitation.

units.source_text: 侍女们在南檐下设一蒲团，请他坐地，却觉得难于应对。

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting laid out a cushion under the southern eaves and invited him to sit, but they found him difficult to deal with.
Princess Ochiba was even more flustered.

units.source_text: 这藏人少将在柏木的诸弟之中相貌最为漂亮，姿态最为优美。

en.t: Among Kashiwagi's younger brothers, this Kuroudo Lesser Captain was the most handsome in appearance and the most graceful in bearing.

units.source_text: 他从容地环视四周，似在回思柏木在世时的光景。

en.t: He calmly looked around, as if recalling how things had been when Kashiwagi was still alive.

units.source_text: 然后对侍女们说：“这里是我常来的地方，一点也不觉得生疏。

en.t: Then he said to the ladies-in-waiting, "This is a place I used to visit often, so it does not feel unfamiliar to me at all.

units.source_text: 但恐你们不当我是亲近的人吧。”

en.t: But I fear that you do not regard me as someone close to you."
He showed a slight sense of dissatisfaction.

units.source_text: 公主看了信，觉得难于作复，她说：“我实在不能写。”

en.t: The princess read the letter and found it difficult to reply, saying, "I truly cannot write one."

units.source_text: 众侍女围集拢来，齐声劝道：“公主不复，太政大臣将谓公主太不懂事。

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting gathered around her and urged her in one voice, "If Your Highness does not reply, the Grand Minister will think you far too lacking in propriety.

units.source_text: 这信是不可以由我们代复的。”

en.t: This is not a letter that we can answer on your behalf."

units.source_text: 公主早已在那里淌眼泪了，她想：“如果母亲在世，我无论做了何等疏误之事，也会庇护我的。”

en.t: The princess was already shedding tears there, thinking, "If my mother were still alive, she would protect me no matter what careless mistake I had made."

units.source_text: 她的眼泪比笔端的墨水先涌出来，许久不能下笔。

en.t: Her tears flowed before the ink at the tip of her brush, and for a long time she could not begin to write.
At last, with great difficulty, she wrote:
